_about: Anime-canon filter for the VS Battles database (npm run wiki:db-build). Forms, stat lines and abilities are tagged anime | manga | both | unclear. Exempt series keep manga/novel content. For the rest, anything matching mangaOnly is excluded from the filtered views and game-stat derivation (raw rows stay in the DB). Anything matching unclear is listed for review in docs/reviews/WIKI_DB_COVERAGE.md. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes matched against the key/form name, the stat text and the ability detail. Coverage notes are as of 2026 and should be updated as new seasons air.
stillAiringPolicy: Only what has aired (owner decision 2026-11-16): forms and feats already shown in the anime count as anime canon; anything not yet animated is excluded from filtered views and stat derivation, the same as manga-only content. Entries in a series' unclear list are treated as not yet animated until confirmed aired.

_aboutLightNovelSeries: These anime adapt light novels, so '(Light Novel)' pages count as the anime's version (content past the anime's coverage is still caught by the series' unclear/mangaOnly patterns). '(Web Novel)' versions differ from the anime and stay excluded.

Dragon Ball.note: Toei anime pages are used. Dragon Ball Super anime ends at the Tournament of Power, plus the Broly and Super Hero films and Daima.

Naruto.note: Boruto anime covers up to the Kawaki arc; Two Blue Vortex is manga-only.

Bleach.note: Thousand-Year Blood War anime parts 1-3 aired 2022-2024; the final part may not cover everything yet.

Jujutsu Kaisen.note: Anime season 3 adapts the Culling Game; the Shinjuku Showdown and later are manga-only.
Jujutsu Kaisen.airedNote: Season 3 aired the first part of the Culling Game: Yuji vs Higuruma, the Sendai colony (Yuta) and Hakari vs Kashimo. Those Culling Game forms count. Choso's 'The Culling Game Arc' key can't be placed confidently in aired episodes, so it stays unclear (excluded).

Black Clover.note: Anime ended at the start of the Spade Kingdom arc; later arcs are manga-only.

Chainsaw Man.note: Anime covers Part 1 through the Reze film; Part 2 is manga-only.

Hunter x Hunter.note: Anime ends with the Election arc; Succession War is manga-only.

Demon Slayer.note: Infinity Castle is being released as films; the final battle may not be fully adapted.

Tokyo Revengers.note: Anime covers through the Tenjiku arc; the Bonten / Kanto Manji / Three Deities / final arcs are manga-only.

Vinland Saga.note: Anime seasons 1-2 cover through Farmland; later arcs are manga-only.

Fairy Tail.note: 100 Years Quest anime started in 2024 and covers only part of the manga. Not confirmed as aired, so excluded: Elentear onward (Post-Elentear, Limit Break), the Dogramag labyrinth and Aldoron (Wood God Dragon) forms.

Record of Ragnarok.note: Anime covers the early rounds; later rounds may be manga-only.

The God of High School.note: The 2020 anime covers the opening and National Competition arcs only.
unairedForms: re: a battle with the gods

Akame ga Kill.note: The anime has its own ending; manga forms differ.

That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime.note: Anime (seasons 1-3 and the movie) covers the light novels up to about the founding festival. Later evolutions (God-Ogre, Devil Lord, Boar God, Divine Wolf, Battle Spirit Oni, Ultimate Slime, Ultimate Skill forms, Empire Invasion and Eastern Empire arcs) have not aired.

Mashle.note: Anime season 2 covers through the Divine Visionary selection.

Overlord.note: Anime covers the light novels up to volume 14.

Fate.note: Anime only. The Lily/Lancer/Archer/Ruler versions of Artoria are game-only; Gilgamesh's Fate/strange Fake 'Original Power' form is not confirmed as aired.

_aboutGame: generic.game: page titles and form names from games or non-canon spin-offs. Always excluded, even for exempt series. Pages whose own note says they are NOT canon are excluded the same way. unairedForms / unairedPages (per series): form names and page titles not yet animated, matched on the name only.
